items.title: zworld_actor_adequacy_locus DISCRIMINATOR: can a capacity-matched supervised adapter reproduce the local_view_greedy oracle from V3-EXQ-978's FROZEN z_world? (H-B consumer-learning vs H-C geometry-mismatch)
items.note: DISCRIMINATOR for hypothesis-space question `zworld_actor_adequacy_locus` (evidence/planning/hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json), routed by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-978_2026-09-03 section 7 fanout_recommendation. claim_ids is DELIBERATELY EMPTY: this adjudicates H-B (consumer-learning) vs H-C (geometry-mismatch), not a claim; INV-088/MECH-457 were recorded PERIPHERAL by 978's own autopsy section 3. Re-derive brake (step 2.5b): does not fire -- no claim is tagged. | DESIGN: behaviour-clone the `local_view_greedy` oracle from a FROZEN latent and ask whether the adapter can reproduce oracle actions. Removes the RL credit-assignment confound that made V3-EXQ-948 (0.5 res/ep) and V3-EXQ-978 OFF (0.267) unattributable. Registered live_gate: CANNOT reproduce -> H-C; CAN reproduce -> H-B. | ARMS (3): rawfield_ceiling (adapter on the raw 25-dim resource_field_view -- the achievable ceiling, measured 0.985/0.980/0.973 held-out); zworld_untrained (NEGATIVE CONTROL -- same 2x128 MLP adapter on an UNTRAINED z_world projection, measured 0.688/0.681/0.695); zworld_off (the 978 OFF-leg frozen latent, the verdict arm). | zworld_on ARM DROPPED, deliberately, with evidence: 978's confirmed autopsy section 2 measured the SD-018 ON leg's effect on the latent at Delta sense-path decode r2 -0.00063, Delta encoder-path r2 +0.00038, Delta participation-ratio +0.0029 -- all two to three orders BELOW the within-arm seed spread (~0.099 r2, ~1.61 PR) and sign-inconsistent across seeds. Three further 350-episode warmups for a foregone conclusion is compute the wave plan refuses; the ON leg is not load-bearing for H-B/H-C separation. | BAR CALIBRATED AGAINST THE CRITERION'S OWN INSTRUMENT (red-team pass 2, Finding 1): AGREEMENT_BAR 0.80 = the measured untrained-z_world ceiling under the SAME 2x128 MLP adapter the criterion uses (0.688/0.681/0.695, worst seed 0.695) + UNTRAINED_CONTROL_MARGIN 0.10, rounded up. Two-step recalibration: 0.50 -> 0.70 (pass 1, against the repeat-previous-action shortcut) -> 0.80 (pass 2, against the untrained-MLP ceiling). Discrimination rests EXPLICITLY on beats_untrained (margin over the untrained control) PLUS elevation over max(majority-class, repeat-previous-executed-action) -- NOT on the absolute bar alone. Effective per-seed pass threshold = max(0.80, trivial+0.20, untrained+0.10) = 0.788/0.781/0.795, reported per seed in interpretation.effective_pass_threshold_per_seed and worst-seed in the summary. Trivial baselines measured: repeat-previous-action 0.566/0.580/0.572, majority-class 0.250/0.248/0.246. | VERDICT GRID CARRIES beats_untrained (red-team pass 2, Finding 2): a 5-cell pure adjudicator (_adjudicate) where H-C REQUIRES not beats_untrained -- trained > untrained by margin is read as H-B evidence, and only trained ~ untrained AND below bar reads as H-C geometry. Two cells the old ladder wrongly absorbed into H-C now exist: H-B-leaning-warmup-non-contributory (clears bar, does not beat untrained -- the registered gate's H-B leg IS satisfied so the H-C corroborator is not owed) and undetermined-partial-support (beats untrained, below bar). The red-team's own worked example (off=0.74, untrained=0.69, trivial=0.57) still lands H-C, and WHY that is correct is written into the self-test comment block: at 0.74 against a raw-field ceiling of 0.98, passing a quarter of the achievable range through z_world IS the geometry failing to carry the mapping. Pushed through the grid as a CONTRACT: --self-test runs 6 named rows plus a whole-boolean-cube invariant asserting no H-C label is ever emitted with beats_untrained=True. 6/6 + cube OK. | FINDINGS 3-5: (3) honesty text added inside the dv_headroom_agreement_elevation check's own description -- measured headroom 0.434/0.420/0.428 vs 0.40 required, ratio 1.05-1.09, deliberately NOT lowered; the stale dv_headroom_agreement_absolute text was corrected (the implication now runs the other way since the bar sits above the floor, measured ratio ~1.22). (4) the untrained arm consults its OWN non-degeneracy gate -- C_verdict_arm_beats_untrained_control is ANDed with the untrained arm being green and with at least one seed carrying a non-null untrained_control_agreement, so a dead control cannot silently certify the comparator. (5) ARM_FEATURE_DIVERGENCE_EPS REMOVED -- moot with the ON arm gone. | KEPT from the prior pass: capacity match BY CONSTRUCTION (the adapter IS x734.PPOPolicyNet at x734.PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, 21,381 action-path params, matching 978's own reader); train-split z-scoring applied identically to all arms with an unstandardised secondary; the dv_headroom precondition class (ree-v3 8e133d26ed); a dry-run that exercises every arm; config_slice carrying the adapter/dataset constants. Leak test: scrambling body_state[5:9] moved agreement 0.677 -> 0.677 (INERT), and the untrained control carries the identical pathway so it cancels. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): decisive readout is oracle_action_agreement of a supervised adapter on a FROZEN 978-OFF latent. No manifest under evidence/experiments/ carries it -- 978 measured LINEAR decode r2 of the resource field (0.70991 sense / 0.85838 encoder), a different instrument answering a different question (information PRESENT vs information USABLE by a policy-capacity reader), and 948 measured PPO foraging with the field side-channelled. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run required. | DV-SYMMETRY, per arm: the DV is per-timestep argmax agreement with the oracle's discrete action, and each arm's manipulation is a change of the adapter's INPUT REPRESENTATION (raw 25-dim field / untrained 32-dim projection / trained-OFF 32-dim latent). A representation change is not a broadcast additive constant, not a monotone rescaling of a rank-based DV, and not a permutation of interchangeable units, so no arm's manipulation is invariant under the DV's symmetry group. | NULL READING is pre-registered per grid cell (5 entries in null_reading, one per cell) so every branch states what it does and does not license. | PRIOR ART: supersedes NOTHING -- V3-EXQ-1002 was reserved and RELEASED unused earlier today; this is its first use. | SMOKE: --self-test 6/6 + boolean-cube invariant (exit 0); validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings across all 31 checks; --dry-run exit 0 with all 3 arms exercised and the correct dry-scale substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route. | red-team (sonnet): CONTESTED (no BLOCKING). Independently re-verified passes 1 and 2 at source and raised ONE structural finding, APPLIED before queueing, plus one informational finding, DISCLOSED rather than fixed. P3-F1: the pass-2 Finding-4 repair fixed only the REPORTED non-degeneracy flag, not the OUTCOME it was meant to protect -- beats_untrained is computed from paired agreements alone and _adjudicate gated only on gate_green / verdict_arm_green, so a COLLAPSED untrained control could score low, hand the verdict arm a free margin and still resolve to PASS / H-B-consumer-learning while the co-emitted flag read False, invisible to a reader taking hypothesis_verdict at face value (which this driver's own docstring instructs). VERIFIED AT SOURCE, then FIXED STRUCTURALLY: comparator_green is now a THIRD readiness gate inside _adjudicate, routing a red comparator to substrate_not_ready_requeue in EITHER direction -- it must not manufacture H-B through a free margin, nor H-C through a vacuous `not beats_untrained` -- and the non-degeneracy flag now reads the SAME quantity, so flag and verdict cannot disagree. Pinned by two named self-test rows plus a SECOND whole-boolean-cube invariant (a red comparator emits nothing but substrate_not_ready_requeue); self-test now 8/8 + 2 cube invariants. P3-F2 (informational, NOT fixed): the leak-inertness evidence (0.677 -> 0.677) was measured at DRY-SCALE warmup (seed 42, 21 train eps), not at this run's 60+200+90 budget, and the live run does not re-measure it -- accepted because the pathway is architectural rather than something training targets AND the untrained control carries the identical pathway so it cancels in the differential; named so a future reader does not mistake an imported offline probe for a run-scale measurement. Pass 3 also independently CONFIRMED: bar arithmetic exact (0.695 + 0.10 -> 0.795, rounded to 0.80); the Finding-2 grid genuinely repaired and cube-verified; F3 disclosed not loosened; F5 moot with no dangling reference to the dropped arm; LocalViewGreedyPolicy reads only resource_field_view, so the V3-EXQ-732a privileged-oracle confound is closed; aggregate_arm_gates semantics correct (non_degenerate = ANY arm green, with verdict_arm_green requiring zworld_off specifically). One dead-configuration note it raised and I confirm: resource_field_weight is inert on this driver's path (only use_resource_field_head matters, and it is identical across arms) -- not a bug.

items.title: MECH-353 blocked-agency floor validation on a headroom DV (z_block_mean)
items.note: Same-question successor to V3-EXQ-642b under a new letter, ratified at the /failure-autopsy Step 8 gate on 2026-09-01 (user present; failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642b_2026-09-01.md section 8) and re-confirmed by governance-20260903T2013. Protocol, environment, seeds (42/43/44), arms (ARM_BLOCK/ARM_CONTROL), P0a SD-070 encoder warmup, P0b SD-056 world-forward training, the per-seed P0 readiness gate, budgets, C0 and C3, and the CALIBRATION_CONFIG under validation (baseline-relative outcome_mismatch floor, ree-v3 d49db86f3e64670) are all inherited VERBATIM from 642b. SOLE CAUSAL CHANGE: the readout. 642b's C1/C2 read z_block_peak, a max against a hard clamp (z_block_cap=1.5, ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py:153); both arms touched 1.500 on all 3 seeds, so the peak separation was exactly 0.000 and C1/C2 were false BY ARITHMETIC, not by measurement. C1/C2 now read the HEADROOM DV z_block_mean (recorded also as z_block_auc_norm -- over a fixed step budget the normalised AUC IS the mean -- with z_block_time_to_threshold_frac banked alongside as the third candidate so a successor need not re-run to compare them). MARGINS RE-DERIVED, NOT TRANSPLANTED: every z_block margin is 20% of Z_BLOCK_CAP = 0.30, an a-priori range-fraction rule stated before the predecessor's separations were looked up, NOT the peak-calibrated 0.20 (which was 13.3% of the same cap, so this re-derivation TIGHTENS the bar as a fraction of the DV's nominal range). The threshold-transplant hazard is why the user chose a new letter over adjudicating 642b's already-recorded mean. NEGATIVE CONTROL for the bar, from the record rather than from fitting: the same statistic on the same protocol gave mean separations 0.1650/0.1214/0.0831 under the legacy absolute floor (642a) and 0.6805/0.5904/0.7709 under the calibrated floor (642b), so 0.30 sits in the gap -- ~1.8x above the highest un-calibrated separation and ~2.0x below the lowest calibrated one, rejecting the un-calibrated regime 3/3 and accepting the calibrated one 3/3, which the dead peak criterion could not do in either regime. FEASIBILITY IS GATED: two dv_headroom preconditions (experiments/_metrics.dv_headroom_check, ree-v3 8e133d26ed) at margin 2.0 -- c1_mean_elevation_headroom_prior (analytic, pre-registered: Z_BLOCK_CAP minus 642b's highest CONTROL mean 0.1768 = 1.3232 achievable against a 0.60 requirement; the peak DV it replaces had 0.000 of that room) and c1_mean_elevation_headroom_measured (ceiling_headroom on THIS run's own CONTROL arm); an unmet headroom precondition on a non-PASS run relabels the interpretation substrate_not_ready_requeue so a starved criterion is never recorded as a falsification. C2 IS FLAGGED, NOT SILENTLY KEPT: ENV_KWARGS pins num_hazards=0 so z_harm_a is flat by construction (642b measured a z_harm_a separation of exactly 0.000 on all 3 seeds) and C2's subtraction is inert -- C2 keeps its formula and keeps gating, but criteria_non_degenerate["C2"] is set false with a recorded reason so no reader counts it as independent confirmation of C1 (V3-EXQ-981 autopsy learning 5). C1's non-degeneracy self-report is re-keyed onto z_block_mean, since the base module reports it off the clamp-pinned peak. SATURATION FRACTION recorded per arm per seed alongside the peak and the (expected-zero) peak separation: the residual that keeps sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration at severity corrupting is that CONTROL still touches 1.500 transiently while sitting at a mean of 0.064-0.177; this run does NOT close that entry. GOAL PINNING DECLARED: the protocol pins z_goal via _pin_goal (direct write, bypasses the counted update_z_goal), which made 642b's manifest report writer_defect:true over 14400 active ticks -- corrected by that autopsy to a mislabelled deliberate control; this driver stamps the z_goal_stream block with goal_pinned=True (ree-v3 209c00fb883) so writer_defect reads "not assessable" rather than a false positive. Existing-evidence check (GOV-REUSE-1): NOT recoverable -- the decisive readout (per-arm z_block_mean) IS in 642b's manifest, but only against thresholds calibrated for the PEAK statistic, so scoring it by reanalysis would require inventing the bar; run required, and cheap (642b elapsed 1465.1s for the full 3-seed x 2-arm grid). Re-derive brake: NOT tripped -- claim_ids is empty and the counted-autopsy tally for MECH-353 is 0. Substrate-path overlap: sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration (severity corrupting, ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py) is still open at status_phase validation_pending, and THIS RUN IS THE VALIDATION IT CALLS FOR -- the same disposition 642b recorded; the substrate is built (implementation_status implemented) and the autopsy explicitly did NOT route to /implement-substrate, so blocking here would deadlock the entry against its own validation. CLAIMLESS: claim_ids [] and evidence_direction forced non_contributory on every outcome; a PASS permits governance -- not this run -- to consider clearing MECH-353 v3_pending. Smoke 2026-09-04: --dry-run completed both arms, printed 2/2 verdict lines, emitted its sentinel, relocated and removed the dry manifest, exited 0; its 2-episode P0 budget fails the scientific criteria as expected and is non-evidentiary. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings. JOINT SATISFIABILITY VERIFIED BY REPLAY before queueing: _evaluate_seed was run over both predecessor manifests' recorded per-seed arm dicts -- over 642a (legacy floor) C0 T / C1 F / C2 F / C3 T on 3/3 seeds (would FAIL), over 642b (calibrated floor) C0 T / C1 T / C2 T / C3 T on 3/3 seeds (would PASS). Neither row is evidence for the calibration (642b's data cannot validate 642b), but together they show the criteria are neither vacuous nor unmeetable at values this substrate actually reaches. Cross-arm contamination checked at source and CLOSED: agent.reset() (ree_core/agent.py:3433-3848) calls blocked_agency.reset() at :3661, which nulls _baseline_mismatch_ema per episode (the explicit V3-EXQ-642a repair), so no EMA state carries from ARM_BLOCK into the sequentially-measured ARM_CONTROL. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, claude-opus-5, one pass): CONTESTED -- 9 findings, all dispositioned in the module docstring; no BLOCKING finding survived verification against source. ACCEPTED+FIXED: (F1) the ATTRIBUTION gate that decides whether a mismatch becomes z_block at all (motor_agency >= attribution_motor_floor, blocked_agency.py:322/:150) and the effective mismatch floor were recorded by NEITHER 642a nor 642b, so their FAILs could not be attributed between 'mismatch below floor', 'attribution gate shut' and 'goal gate' -- blocked_agency.get_state() exposes all of it and is called nowhere in the family; this run now records per arm motor_agency mean/min, motor_gate_shut_frac, the live floor, effective_mismatch_floor_mean, n_external_block_ticks and the final baseline EMA, at zero extra compute (every value was already on the output object the loop reads). (F8) the base keys C1/C2/C3 non-degeneracy on the clamp-pinned z_block_peak, so the vacuity detector built because C3 once passed vacuously reported non-degenerate unconditionally -- all three re-keyed onto z_block_mean. (F6) base.run_experiment denominates the 2/3 seed floor on the REALIZED ready-seed count, so 1-of-1 ready seeds would carry a validation label -- now flagged via seed_base_sufficient / seed_base_note. ACCEPTED+DISCLOSED: (F3) with num_hazards=0, C1 implies C2, so the grid's z_block_tracks_z_harm_a_not_dissociated branch is unreachable; (F4) the measured headroom gate is monotone in the direction that makes the substrate look testable and cannot catch a dead comparator -- C0 ordering does that, and the headroom preconditions guard only the clamp degeneracy that killed 642b; (F7) arms are not counterbalanced and C3's policy-arm rates are order-confounded (residue/hippocampal state is not reset), left unfixed because the autopsy ratified 'keep C0 and C3 as they stand'. DISMISSED WITH CITATION: (F2) 'toroidal geometry guarantees the separation' -- refuted by 642a, same env and training, separations 0.165/0.121/0.083 all BELOW the 0.30 bar, so the separation depends on the floor calibration under test, not geometry; (F5) 'the BLOCK mean is clamp-censored' -- 642b's BLOCK means were 0.81/0.77/0.83, ~55% of the 1.5 cap, not near it (its other half accepted: saturation_frac is now surfaced per arm per seed); (F9) 'cross-arm RNG desync' -- _build_env(seed, block) builds a fresh env with the SAME seed per arm, so there is no shared stream. Smoke re-run green after the fixes; new diagnostic keys verified to populate.

items.title: EXT-002 residue error-persistence, REDESIGNED with a headroom-derived decline_gap bar (C1 0.15 -> 0.04, from 983's own measured control range 0.046790), a runtime dv_headroom precondition, and a training-completion gate before seeds are pooled
items.note: REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-983 (supersedes), routed by the confirmed failure_autopsy_ext-claim-probe-cluster_2026-09-03 section 6 and ratified by governance-20260903T2013. THE DEFECT BEING REPAIRED: 983's DV `decline_gap` realised a range of only 0.0468 across all six cells against a C1 threshold of 0.15 (3.2x short), so the registered effect could not have been observed under any outcome; and its seed population was ungated (steps_realized_frac 0.077/0.085/0.965, harm_rate_train ~31x apart), so equal-weight pooling produced the -0.45pp gap. WEAK NULL CARRIED, NOT ERASED (governance red-team amendment 4): 983's P3 positive control PASSED at 51x and the manipulation reached behaviour (action-stream divergence 0.186-0.295), yet decline_gap did not move -- the prior here is a weak null on the rider prediction, and this run is the first powered to tell a second null from an unpowered one. FOUR CHANGES: (1) C1 0.15 -> 0.04, DERIVED from the predecessor's own measured control-arm range 0.046790 (0.04 = 85.5% of it, 2.07 SD above the 0.019321 cross-seed paired-delta noise floor), and RUNTIME-GATED by the `dv_headroom` precondition kind (ree-v3 8e133d26ed, substrate entry dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class) measuring statistic=range over every pooled cell in BOTH arms at margin 1.0 -- below it the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue and never to a verdict on EXT-002. (2) TRAINING-COMPLETION GATE before seeds are pooled: a seed contributes only if BOTH arms clear steps_realized_frac >= 0.60 AND harm_rate_train <= 0.35, each sitting in the empty gap between 983's trained and untrained seed populations; excluded seeds are recorded in full, never deleted. (3) 8 seeds x 2 arms x 110 ep x 200 steps = 352,000 planned steps, 2.2% UNDER the predecessor's 360,000 -- eight draws of the board lottery for no extra compute; MIN_POOLED_SEEDS=2 is the P6 readiness floor. (4) P5 (harm_rate_not_saturated) replaced by P6 (pooled_seed_count) -- the 0.35 completion ceiling is strictly stricter than P5's 0.90, so retaining P5 would be tautological. claim_ids = EXT-002 + ARC-013 (NOT the ARC-005/INV-008 the chip text suggested): the A1 manipulation ablates residue-as-persistent-latent-curvature, which is ARC-013; neither ARC-005 (control-plane precision routing) nor INV-008 (depth-specific precision) is manipulated or read anywhere in this design, and INV-006 is derivational. Flagged to governance for ratification. Re-derive brake (step 2.5b): does NOT fire -- EXT-002 count 1, ARC-013 count 0, both below threshold 2. GOV-REUSE-1 / step 2.4: decisive readout is decline_gap under a headroom-gated DV over a training-complete seed population; checked the only prior run carrying it (v3_exq_983_ext002_residue_error_persistence_20260903T150005Z_v3) -- it records decline per cell but on an ungated seed population, with per-episode env re-randomisation and a different substrate_hash, so the readout is NOT recoverable post-hoc and the run is required. red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> six findings, all dispositioned in the module docstring; two CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT and fixed: F1 (the DV was conditioned on an env-determined event -- CausalGridWorldV2.reset() re-placed hazards every episode, so 983's repeat_rate was largely the env's per-episode lottery; FIXED by rebuilding the env from the same seed each episode and env_drift_prob 0.1 -> 0.0, plus a NEW precondition P7 revisit_outcome_heterogeneity requiring >=10% of erred keys to have resolved both ways) and F4-B (PreconditionSpec.met_for is strict while the REE_assembly indexer recomputes inclusively, so an integer count on an integer threshold read UNMET in-script and MET in the indexer; FIXED by making both integer floors half-integers). Also fixed: F4-A (headroom range now over BOTH arms, not the control alone -- a control-only range is anti-correlated with the runs it should protect), F2 (a C4 data-quality miss now self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue instead of `weakens`, because C4's failure signature IS the success signature), F3 (evidence_direction_per_claim branches: on a null EXT-002 takes weakens, ARC-013 takes mixed, since P1 is direct evidence FOR ARC-013's persistence property), F4-C (accepted as a diagnostic: completion_gate.exclusion_asymmetry reports every seed excluded because exactly one arm cleared the band). Smoke: dry-run PASS (runs end-to-end, gates fire and route); validate_experiments --strict OK.
